plain_text:
Foreign language translations may be added as text after the label image in the same file with the label OR they may
be submitted as separate documents.
semantic_text: Foreign language translations may be added as text after the label image in the same file with the label OR they may be submitted as separate documents.

plain_text:
If they are separate documents and a submission contains more than one label, ensure that each file
name allows the CVB to easily associate the translation with a specific label.
semantic_text: If they are separate documents and a submission contains more than one label, ensure that each file name allows the CVB to easily associate the translation with a specific label.

plain_text:
Proposed label text for products that have an assigned product code may be submitted as “sketches”
for CVB comment. If you wish to have a label submission considered solely as a sketch, add “For
consideration as a sketch” to the body of the mounting sheet.
semantic_text: Proposed label text for products that have an assigned product code may be submitted as “sketches” for CVB comment. If you wish to have a label submission considered solely as a sketch, add “For consideration as a sketch” to the body of the mounting sheet.

plain_text:
Labels submitted as sketches will be returned as sketches. Sketches must be followed by a final label
submission for formal CVB approval prior to use.
semantic_text: Labels submitted as sketches will be returned as sketches. Sketches must be followed by a final label submission for formal CVB approval prior to use.

plain_text:
Once follow these step-by-step instructions for customer scaling page size in Adobe PRO, the function will remain
set in Adobe all the time (on every document done after that). This is a one-time set up. You may need to change
the actual size depending on the doc, but function will always be there.
